title: Yen Press Licenses Witches Can't Be Collared, 'Alma-chan Wants to Be a Family!', Yamada's Class Diary, More Manga/Novels
content: Yen Press announced on Friday that it has licensed eight manga, six novel series, and one box set for release in December 2026.
author: ANN

title: Viz Media to Release Jujutsu Kaisen Modulo, Detective Conan, Slam Dunk Deluxe Edition, Junji Ito: Dissection, More Manga
content: Viz Media announced on Friday that it has licensed the following manga and novels for print in English for release in spring 2027 (with one in fall 2027): Viz Media currently publishes the ongoing manga in single volumes as Case Closed with localized names and a title based on Funimation 's original English dub .
author: ANN

title: Jujutsu Kaisen’s Sequel Confirms New Release After Finale
content: The beloved sequel manga series, Jujutsu Kaisen Modulo , written by Gege Akutami and illustrated by Yuji Iwasaki, reached its conclusion in March this year. As a sequel to the original story, the manga serialization in September 2025 was confirmed to run for six months and release no more than three volumes.
author: ComicBook

title: Seth MacFarlane’s New Animated Series Drops New Details
content: It’s impossible to deny at this point that Seth MacFarlane has become a force of nature within the animated world. With the likes of Family Guy and American Dad set for several new seasons in the future, MacFarlane is confirmed to branch out, thanks to a Stewie spin-off series that is also in the works.
author: ComicBook

title: Cancelled Nickelodeon Series Returns With Surprise Renewal
content: In the face of the potential merging of Paramount/Skydance and Warner Bros Discovery, the fate of Nickelodeon and its animated properties remains a point of contention for many fans.
author: ComicBook

title: Cyberpunk Is Officially Making a Major Comeback Thanks To These 3 Upcoming Sci-Fi TV Shows
content: The arrival of a trio of upcoming sci-fi shows proves beyond a shadow of a doubt that cyberpunk is making a major comeback in 2026. Even though a lot of the sci-fi subgenre’s most important books have been adapted to the screen, cyberpunk has always struggled to carve out a mainstream niche for itself.
author: ComicBook

title: New Godzilla Trailer Highlights Minus One’s Mechagodzilla
content: The King of the Monsters has had one of the biggest years in the kaiju’s long history. Earlier this year, Apple TV released the second season of Monarch: Legacy of Monsters , bringing monster fans back to the West’s MonsterVerse.
author: ComicBook

title: Alleged Operator of Webtoon Piracy Website Newtoki Extradited From Japan to S. Korea
content: The suspected operator behind Newtoki, one of South Korea's largest illegal webtoon distribution sites, was extradited from Japan to Korea, marking a major breakthrough in its efforts to combat global digital piracy.
author: ANN

title: 'Dark Summoner to Dekiteiru' Reveals Main Cast, Staff, Fall 2026 Debut
content: WWWaveCorporation 's Deregula animation label opened an official website for the television anime adaptation of Shaoh 's Dark Summoner to Dekiteiru ( I'm Dating a Dark Summoner ) web manga on Friday, revealing the main cast, production staff, and a key visual (pictured).
